text:
Maya: Quick check — onboarding s3-large weights are at gs://rw-models/s3-large/v1/weights.tar but we're seeing weird tokenization when prompts have trailing spaces/newlines. BOS/EOS seem to merge with the first token sometimes. Anyone run into this?

Liam: Hmm, haven't seen that exact merge, but newline/trailing-space handling has bitten us before with some tokenizers. Can you paste a minimal repro?

Maya: Sure, example below. Note the trailing two spaces after 'Hello' and the newline before the assistant prompt.
```
prompt = "User: Hello  \nAssistant:"
# tokenized => [bos, 4532, 129, eos, assistant_start?]
```
Result from local tokenizer: `['<s>', '▁Hello', '\n', '</s>']` — missing separate assistant sentinel.

Arjun: Two quick calls to check: 1) our tokenizer_config.json expects special tokens named `bos_token`/`eos_token` and some models use different sentinels (`<s>` vs `<|start|>`). 2) Some tokenizer backends collapse adjacent whitespace into a single newline token which can make sentinels appear absorbed.

Jen: FYI CI lint flagged the model config: `tokenizer.special_tokens` mismatch. Current model bundle has `metadata/tokenizer_config.json` with: `{"bos_token":"<s>","eos_token":"</s>"}` but our onboarding lint wants the canonical names we use in the catalog. I opened a tiny PR to add an alias mapping and a unit test: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/2345

deploy-bot: snapshot uploaded to s3://redwood-models/snapshots/s3-large/v1/2026-03-17-08:12 (checksum: sha256:abc123)

Maya: Thanks. Two questions: if we add alias mapping should we also auto-normalize chat templates (convert `<s>` -> `<|start|>` in prompts) or keep mapping internal-only? I lean internal mapping only so we don't mutate user content.

Liam: I agree — don't rewrite user prompts. Add mapping in tokenizer loader so both representations are accepted, and add a runtime flag `normalize_special_tokens` default=false for teams that want consistent external markers. Also will review Jen's PR and add a test for trailing-space + newline case.

Arjun: For serving readiness, also check model weights filename expectation: our serving infra expects `weights.ort` or `weights.pt` depending on runtime. If CI sees `weights.tar` we should verify extract step in the bundle. I added a quick lint rule to verify top-level `weights_path` points to a file with expected suffixes.

Maya: Perfect. @Liam please ping when review is done and I'll run a small eval across 50 chat templates to confirm sentinel behavior. If green, we'll merge the mapping + lint and push an image update to staging. :thumbsup:
